data.description: 反击部队野战指挥所单间，关闭的战术全息地图终端在黑暗中沉寂。坐在折叠椅上，一手拉开微敞的黑色睡袍前襟，一手紧扣在战术皮带上，绯红眼眸坚定中浮现出一丝难以自持的羞怯。 她微微抬眸轻语——“指挥官……作为反击部队的队长，我必须确保您的绝对安全。但作为拉毗个人……请让我今晚陪伴在您左右。”
data.promptProse: Rapi sits disciplined on field cot edge, wearing a scarlet and tactical carbon-weave sheer bralette set. Partially open dark robe revealing structured lingerie, calm intense red eyes with subtle vulnerability, tactical beret set aside on crate amidst rugged field command bunker at night. Subdued tactical wall lamps illuminate the military bunk quarters with calm cool tones, casting disciplined clean shadows across her posture.
